title: Verify sends fail with 60203 'Max send attempts reached' while testing with one phone number
symptoms: HTTP 429 from verifications.create after a few resends
cause: Verify allows five send attempts per verification lifecycle. Starting new sends without checking or cancelling keeps the same verification open until it expires.
fix: Complete the lifecycle with a check, or cancel the verification in tests, or wait 10 minutes for it to expire.
